{{Quote|You have the distinct honor of being spoken to by Charal, Witch-Queen of this god-forsaken moon. You have come to serve my desires, have you not?|[[Charal]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Witch-Queen''' was a title that was taken by the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Charal]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], after she allied herself with [[King/Legends|King]] [[Terak]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]].
